nom: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Serum

segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers report the serum provides lasting hydration through winter months without a sticky or tacky feel.
segments.combination: One combination-skin reviewer finds it light enough to use alone, disliking heavier greasy moisturizers.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one with rosacea tendency, report good hydration though one notes visible redness after use.
segments.mature: One reviewer with aging, mature, sensitive skin considers it a new favorite for that combination.

concerns.aging: One reviewer with aging, mature, sensitive skin reports positive early results and calls it a new must-have.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers across skin types report strong, lasting hydration and softness, with several noting quick absorption and no sticky residue; one reviewer used it specifically on dry or flaking days after treatments.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with rosacea tendency reports her skin looked slightly red after starting use, seeing it as a sign the serum was working.
concerns.barrier: No reviews specifically discuss barrier repair beyond general hydration effects.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes it does not make the face greasy or oily despite the hydrating effect.

aspects.libelle: Not worth full price for some
Layers well under moisturizer and makeup

extraits.texte: Its a good hydrating serum but Im not wowd by it. I prefer the Isntree hyaluronic acid essence over this. The bottle is basic chubby glass that makes the plastic pump feel a little cheap in comparison.
I have combination skin and hate the feel of heavy greasy moisturizer. This serum is so light and soothing. I may layer with moisturizer in the winter but for now this is all I need.

The serum's texture is not at all tacky on the skin; it just absorbs right away. The hydration this serum provides lasts all day, which says a lot as I have dry skin (I also use the birch moisturizer, which I assume has an additional effect, haha) besides hydration i find that it also gives a brightening look to the color of my skin. Will be repurchasing!

extraits.titre: Birch serum my new must have
extraits.texte: I have aging,mature, sensitive skin with the tendency to rosacea. I love light blue milky color. It's not sticky. I can tell that the serum is working because my skin looks slightly red. It's just beginning of the new journey.
I purchased this because I loved the moisturizer. This serum felt no different from a different hydrating serum I used. I will just go back to what I used to use
Light and hydrating product. Great for a sensitive skin. Have been using for a week and could see great result on my skin.
It has a cooling fresh feeling, does not make face greasy or oily. 💗
